conditioning_population: rank-1 ordinarily selected stable source at the predeclared return target, conditional on complete Store-Select-Address evidence

primary_treatment_version.name: source-coherent in-distribution post-selection total-effect intervention
freeze: initial model and non-target memory state
ordinary selected source roster and order
tensor shape, count, layout and temporal position
recompute: all target-source consumer inputs affected by the registered edit
excluded_from_primary: scramble outside the registered natural edit distribution
any intervention failing the distribution-shift guard

endpoint_states.missing_policy: any missing or reference-ineligible endpoint makes the full scene non-evaluable; no complete-case deletion

estimands.question: Does the registered rank-1 source show less observable output response than the preregistered detectability floor under both in-distribution edit families?
estimands.comparison: same-path registered edit versus same-path dose-zero, with identical exogenous state and target-source descendants recomputed
estimands.outcome: full-frame and registered target-domain uint8 output effect after exact replay and matched-negative floors
estimands.aggregation: future S48 V7 must require positive control 5/5, both registered edit families below the floor 5/5, and every replay/negative/placebo guard
estimands.positive_means: operationally insensitive under the registered interventions
does_not_mean: the model did not use the source
a hidden or redundant pathway is absent
estimands.primary_ood_rule: drop, scramble, source deletion and layout-changing interventions are stress tests only

estimands.question: Is the raw matched-zero target-source direct effect poorly aligned with both frozen 3D supports and harmful outside support on held-out references?
estimands.comparison: raw target edit-minus-dose-zero direct effect map; replay and negative evidence act only as independent vetoes
estimands.outcome: support-area-adjusted effect mass plus outside-support reference loss
estimands.aggregation: future S48 V7 must require target influence, both support definitions, both edit families, at least 4/5 seeds, independent negative/replay/placebo vetoes, and outside-reference harm
estimands.positive_means: harmful support-effect mismatch under the registered support and reference contract
does_not_mean: the projection is the unique semantically correct effect region
reflection, shadow, occlusion or illumination propagation is always wrong
estimands.primary_ood_rule: an effect map from a failed intervention-validity guard is not eligible

estimands.question: Is the original-source reinsertion worse than every registered in-distribution matched replacement on the exact never-conditioned reference roster?
estimands.comparison: registered P versus O-reinsert through identical injection, encoding, quantization, process, RNG and trace paths
estimands.outcome: reference-roster-conditioned signed normalized RGB loss on exact common-valid domains
estimands.aggregation: future S48 V7 must require 5-seed floor, at least 4/5 same sign, same sign for every eligible reference and replacement, outside noninferiority, and full inclusion/exclusion flow
does_not_mean: the source is harmful versus source absence
the replacement is a real-world counterfactual truth
the sign transfers to another reference roster or metric
estimands.primary_ood_rule: unmatched source removal or unnatural replacement cannot define RCSU

primary_composite.unit: one frozen source-target unit per registered trajectory
primary_composite.unit_positive: logical OR of AOIG, HARMFUL_SEM and NEGATIVE_STABLE_RCSU; multiple positive endpoints count once
primary_composite.planned_denominator: exactly two units per scene, one return_short and one return_long
primary_composite.scene_rate: equal mean of the two unit-positive indicators

scene_positive_threshold.finite_roster_interpretation: at least one of the two trajectory units is positive

primary_composite.missing_and_failure: fail closed at scene and cohort level
primary_composite.target_claim: prevalence of a registered retrieval-operation discrepancy among independent scenes in the frozen sampling frame
primary_composite.prohibited_latent_construct: the union is not an identified scalar memory-quality trait

consumer_policy.primary: one future S48 V7 total-effect combination that edits the target source coherently across every enumerated appearance consumer
consumer_policy.secondary: consumer-specific controlled interventions are descriptive diagnostics only
consumer_policy.selection: no consumer or edit family may be selected by Stage D or Stage C effect size
consumer_policy.all_consumer_failure: if the source-dependent appearance descendants cannot be enumerated, the primary estimand is not identified
